usageNote: 被动句型「be called + 名称」，超常用！给某物起绰号专用，说话带点介绍感，像导游解说那种范儿～

examples.en: Camels are called the ships of the desert because they carry heavy loads across the sand.
examples.zh: 骆驼被称为沙漠之舟，因为它们驮着重物穿越沙漠。

examples.en: These animals are called the ships of the desert by the people who live there.
examples.zh: 这些动物被当地人称为沙漠之舟。
